summary: The filing reports that Cyber App Solutions Corp. entered an agreement to defer a foreclosure originally scheduled for June 2, 2026, with a revised auction date of July 7, 2026, unless settlement of convertible promissory notes dated November 21, 2023 is reached. The company is evaluating options and engaging with investors Kips Bay Select, LP and Cyber One, LTD. Notes are convertible into common stock, and failure to settle could lead to foreclosure, potentially wiping out equity or diluting shareholders. The OTC Pink listing carries no automatic halt. Watch for settlement terms or auction outcome: if no deal by July 7, noteholders gain control, creating deep-distressed risk-arb spread.
